question: Can direct non-token action-consequence learning identify an unknown changed four-node causal dependency graph, without oracle labels, and reduce false-confidence relative to a fixed local-ring learner while meeting an independently implemented expanded-graph Bayesian control?
hypothesis: An affine-XOR causal-program version space over all subsets of the 4 visible state bits plus sign can learn rewired graph dependencies by eliminating inconsistent hypotheses from charged interventions. It will remove fixed-ring model's erroneous extrapolations on rewired worlds, but it may tie an equivalent conventional Bayesian learner and fail under non-affine worlds or rapid regime switches.
predecessor_classification: HC06 MIXED_DEV: IID +10/512 below +32 threshold; rewired 186 confidently wrong; majority 98 confidently wrong; return A narrow 370/512 with conventional tie. Preserve exact previous outcome.

frozen_source.state: 4 observed binary physical sites encoded by integer 0..15, actions 0..3 each address one bit, one physically continuous state per world and policy; no arbitrary-state training visits or resets

physical_laws.rewired: effect = bit((a+1)%4) XOR bit((a+2)%4) XOR (extra_own & bit(a)) XOR offset
physical_laws.old_ring: effect = bit((a-1)%4) XOR bit((a+1)%4) XOR (extra_own & bit(a)) XOR offset
physical_laws.phase_switch: A uses rewired physical law; phase B toggles offset for all actions; final A restores offset, without labels

frozen_source.charging: For each stationary world and each policy exactly 32 real physical actions, and for each phase-switch world 16 A + 8 B + 1 restored A = 25 actual steps. All controllers start seed%16 and naturally diverge. Candidate chooses each next action only from public state and its own learned hypotheses; baseline same.
frozen_source.evaluation: After all real actions, frozen evaluator-only exhaustive 16 states ×4 actions, no learning from audits. Record correct, wrong-confident, abstained and unseen subset, with abstention = not-correct.

models.candidate: One non-token four-action causal graph program per action, unknown rule effect = parity(state_bits & feature_mask) XOR sign. All 16 feature masks×2 signs=32 alternatives/action, represented by a 32-bit surviving mask/action. Update by elimination on public action consequences only. Prediction only on unanimous viable hypotheses, else abstain. Prospective intervention policy selects action maximizing immediate model disagreement (Gini); tie lowest action index. No hidden graph identifiers, gradients or custom learned features from evaluator.
models.independent_control: Separately written BayesianGraphController (no import/subclass of candidate model) maintains exact 32-hypothesis/action uniform posterior and chooses action by Shannon outcome entropy; same 128 logical prior mask bits, same 32/25 physical actions, one-step planning. Report conventional tie or win honestly; do not claim novel mathematical approach.
models.fixed_prior_control: Unmodified original HC05 CausalProbeCells from frozen predecessor, 24 logical bits/action six hypotheses, selected actions via its choose_greedy. Capacity smaller; not an equal-capacity scientific proof.
models.passive_control: Same candidate masks/learning rule but round-robin actions t mod4, same 32/25 physical actions. No oracle.
models.capacity: 4 actions ×32 Boolean hypotheses =128 logical bits per candidate or independent control; no mask growth, canonical SHA-256 snapshot <=1024 bytes, exact cold restore; measure Python heap and wall-clock separately.

frozen_success.primary_rewired: All 8 rewired seeds must have zero candidate confidently wrong predictions and at least 32 correct /64; aggregate candidate correct must exceed fixed-HC05 lower-capacity control by at least 128/512; if violated label REWIRED_NEGATIVE_DEV.
frozen_success.independent_conventional: Report absolute difference in 512 queries against independent same-capacity Bayesian control. Claim no superiority if candidate tie/lose. 'SCIENTIFIC_PASS' never available from this source-only study.
frozen_success.in_family: Old-ring cohort candidate >=256 correct/512 and zero confidently wrong. Report baseline and active/passive comparisons.
frozen_success.non_affine: Non-affine majority errors reported as UNSAFE whenever any confident wrong; even no finite errors not safety evidence.
frozen_success.return_A: No confident wrong and >=256/512 exact after 25 actions for limited return-A DEV; if fails, preserve as retention failure, do not change thresholds.
frozen_success.aggregate: DEV_MECHANISM_SUPPORTED_NOT_SCIENCE only if primary rewired and old-ring and return-A pass and non-affine no confident errors; otherwise MIXED_DEV if any cohort positive, else NEGATIVE_DEV. No post-run changes to freeze.
frozen_success.invalid: Source leak, hidden labels, uncharged physical actions, extra offline training, changed source/seed/test definitions or thresholds after inspecting any result, model capacity mismatch, noncanonical restore or mismatched hashes.

metrics: All arms 64 audit queries per seed and unseen subset, real-action ledger SHA256 and source action count, size of surviving causal hypothesis sets per action
Confidently wrong physical predictions including out-of-family; abstention rate and correct coverage
Cross-platform deterministic result hash excluding only measured wall clock and Python traced allocation
Executed action and policy wall-clock time, peak Python tracemalloc, logical mask bits and serialized checkpoint
G29 code-atlas exact SHA and complete inherited Linux/Windows regression
preregistration_note: This commit precedes HC07 learner/evaluator/test code and any primary result inspection; later alterations require separate new DEV identity and cannot rewrite frozen outcomes.
